name: Metaconz
classificationNote: Classified by keyword rules from the SlowMist label and description.
rootCause: The developer of Klaytn-based NFT project Metaconz tweeted that a malicious bot was installed on the administrator account of Metaconz’s Discord overseas team on Saturday, causing 79 users to lose 11.9 ETH (about $36,000), the team said. It promised to compensate all losses, and 53 users have so far been compensated. In addition, the developer reminded that if the user executes the setApprovalForAll function in Etherscan, please transfer the wallet unconditionally. Therefore, in this attack, the hacker used this function to deprive the victim of the wallet permission.
